data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 posits a causal mechanism (school-0 demand) by splitting failure modes: unified codebase causes logic corruption to cascade across all centralized nodes, while diverse codebases in decentralized services prevent total failure. However, this mechanism does not address what evidence distinguishes failures that are truly independent from those that merely appear uncorrelated until a shared cause is found, a core requirement of the problem. The two counterconditions (cellular architecture, undersized services) are asserted without derivation or observation, leaving the central problem context unmet.
